title: Manim Animations
summary: Short mathematical films rendered with Manim.

animations.title: Kinematic rotation of △ABC about a point on line L
animations.description: Fix a point $O$ on a line $L$. The isometry is rotation of the plane about $O$ through a fixed angle $\theta$ (here $60^\circ$). For $t \in [0, 1]$, every point $P$ moves at constant distance from $O$ so that the directed angle $\angle POP(t) = t\theta$. Triangle $\triangle ABC$ is carried as a rigid body: its vertices travel on circular arcs centered at $O$, the side lengths stay fixed, and $L$ rotates onto a line $L'$ through $O$ at angle $\theta$. This illustrates the distance-preserving mappings in Lang, Basic Mathematics, Chapter 6, §1.

animations.title: Mapping of the plane into itself
animations.description: A mapping of the plane into itself associates to each point $P$ a point $P'$, written $P \mapsto P'$. The point $P'$ is the value of the mapping at $P$, also called the image of $P$. Naming the mapping $F$, one writes $F(P) = P'$. Two mappings are equal precisely when they take the same value at every point: $F = G$ if and only if $F(P) = G(P)$ for every point $P$.
